bug_info.bug_desc: The reseed and generate command FIFO clear signals are gated by edn_enable, so when the EDN is disabled the clear inputs are forced to 0. As a result, a software-requested command FIFO reset or a main_sm_done_pulse cannot clear the FIFOs while the module is disabled. Stale reseed/generate commands can remain in the FIFOs and be sent out after the module is re-enabled, which can cause unwanted commands or a stuck CSRNG interface. This violates the requirement that all pending command paths be cleared while the module is disabled.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the edn_enable gating from sfifo_rescmd_clr and sfifo_gencmd_clr so the command FIFOs are cleared directly by cmd_fifo_rst_fo and main_sm_done_pulse regardless of the EDN enable state.
